config.protocol_retry: default at most 2 requests per decision; shared budget

subgoals.description: Turn right 0.6 rad from initial yaw 0.0 to sweep the right hemisphere for blue ball A; reference is current heading, endpoint yaw <= -0.5 rad.
Sweep back left through original heading to the opposite side, ending yaw >= 0.5 rad, to look for A where the right sweep did not cover.
Short forward translation of 0.25 m toward the observed open floor ahead-left of tracked green candidate to gain a new viewpoint; endpoint measured forward pose.x_m >= 0.15 m.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, re-inspect fresh geometry (tracked point-001 range/bearing and pose), then either resume the opposite sweep or take a different short viewpoint move; abort if geometry shows no safe direction.

subgoals.description: Sweep right hemisphere for blue ball A: turn right from current yaw 0.465 rad by 0.6 rad, committing to a rightward scan; endpoint yaw <= -0.1 rad.

plans_in_md.recovery: Re-observe fresh geometry; if A still not visible, take a short supported translation or sweep the opposite direction; abort if no safe option.

subgoals.description: Turn left 0.55 rad from yaw ~-0.23 to yaw >= 0.30, committing to a leftward scan for blue ball A while keeping confirmed green block B as the observed reference on the left-front.
If A still unseen, take a short 0.25 m forward viewpoint change toward the open floor in front of the tracked B ray (point-005 at ~1.56 m), endpoint when point-005.range_m <= 1.35 m.

plans_in_md.recovery: Re-observe fresh geometry; if A is still not visible and forward clearance is unsupported, sweep the opposite side or abort with a reason rather than looping turns.

subgoals.description: Move 0.3 m forward along the clear visible ray toward confirmed green block B (point-006 at 1.62 m, bearing 0.076 rad left of heading) to change viewpoint and search for the unseen blue ball A; endpoint when point-006.range_m <= 1.42.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, re-observe fresh geometry, then scan the unexamined right side (negative yaw) for A, or abort with a reason if no geometry supports motion.

subgoals.description: Rotate right 0.6 rad (yaw 0.29 -> about -0.31) to survey the not-yet-examined right side for blue ball A, keeping the visible green candidate B (point-007, bearing 0.15 rad, range 3.28 m) as a stable geometric reference. No translation, so no collision exposure during the scan.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and re-observe fresh geometry; if A is visible, track its pixel and inspect geometry before approaching; if not, switch branch to a short forward translation along the evidenced clear ray to point-007 (B candidate) and inspect the new view.

subgoals.description: Rotate left 0.6 rad to survey the previously unexamined left sector for blue ball A, using the tracked green candidate point-008 (bearing 0.43 rad, range 1.31 m ahead-left) as a stable reference; endpoint is yaw near +0.34 rad. No translation, so no collision exposure.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and re-observe fresh geometry; if blue A becomes visible, track its pixel and inspect geometry before approaching; if not, change branch to a short translation along an evidenced direction with point-008 kept as reference, then inspect the new view.

subgoals.description: Translate forward 0.3 m along the only evidenced clear ray (tracked green candidate point-009, bearing 0.175 rad, range 2.63 m ahead) to change viewpoint and survey for blue ball A; endpoint when point-009 range drops to <=2.35 m

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, observe fresh geometry; if blue A becomes visible track its pixel and inspect geometry, otherwise pick another evidenced viewpoint change or abort with reason

subgoals.description: Rotate right 0.5 rad in place from current yaw 0.271 rad to sweep the unexplored right side of the view (away from green candidate point-010 at bearing +0.19 rad) looking for blue ball A; endpoint when pose.yaw_rad <= -0.15 rad

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe fresh frame; if blue A is visible, track its pixel and inspect geometry; if still no A after this sweep, choose a short translation to a new viewpoint with evidenced clearance or abort with reason

subgoals.description: Commit to a forward search leg along tracked reference point-012 (range ~1.55 m, bearing +0.13 rad ahead-left); translate forward 0.3 m to a new viewpoint to reveal occluded scene; endpoint pose.x_m >= 0.85

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, observe a fresh frame; if blue A is visible track its pixel and inspect geometry; otherwise re-evaluate with another short evidenced translation or abort with reason

subgoals.description: Turn left 0.6 rad away from the already-seen green B toward unexplored sector, sweeping for blue ball A; endpoint heading pose.yaw_rad >= 0.93 (from 0.345)
After the left turn, translate ~0.3 m forward-left from the new heading (yaw~0.94) to a fresh viewpoint that reveals cabinet-occluded areas; endpoint pose.y_m >= 0.65

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; if blue A is visible track its pixel and inspect get_geometry; if geometry is insufficient abort with a reason; otherwise pick one evidenced short translation and inspect again.

subgoals.description: Commit to one short forward-left leg from current yaw 0.89 rad along the bearing of tracked floor point-015 (1.13 m ahead, 0.22 m left, clear floor); endpoint pose.y_m >= 0.90

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-015 and any fresh visual candidates; if blue A becomes visible track its pixel, else abort with reason if no motion is supported

subgoals.description: Commit to one short forward-left leg along the bearing of tracked floor point-016 (1.09 m ahead, 0.26 m left) from current yaw 0.90 rad; endpoint when point-016 range closes from 1.12 m to <= 0.78 m

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-016 and any fresh visual candidates; if the floor reference is lost, re-select a floor point and change viewing direction; abort with reason if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Commit to one forward-left leg along the bearing of the fresh tracked floor point-017 (1.167 m ahead, 0.229 rad left of camera forward) from current yaw 0.92 rad; endpoint when point-017 range closes from 1.167 m to <= 0.90 m

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-017 and any fresh visual candidates; if the floor reference is lost, re-select another floor point or change viewing direction with a short turn; abort with reason if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Review due: switch reference from lost point-017 to fresh tracked floor point-018 (1.136 m ahead, bearing 0.009 rad) and commit to a short forward leg from current yaw 0.92 rad; endpoint when point-018 range closes to <= 0.80 m

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-018 and any fresh visual candidates; if the floor reference is lost, re-select another floor point or change viewing direction with a short turn; abort with reason if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Commit to forward motion along current heading (yaw ~0.93 rad) referenced by the fresh tracked floor point-019 (1.27 m ahead, bearing 0.17 rad); endpoint when point-019 range closes to <=0.85 m, then re-scan new view for blue A / green B

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-019 and visual_candidates; if the floor reference is lost, reselect another point or switch scan direction with a short turn; abort if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Commit to forward motion along current heading (yaw ~0.94 rad) referenced by fresh tracked floor point-020 at 1.07 m, bearing -0.06 rad; endpoint when point-020 range closes to <=0.70 m, then re-scan the new view for blue A / green B before any further leg

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-020 and visual_candidates; if the reference is lost or geometry unknown, reselect another tracked point or switch scan direction with a short turn; abort if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Commit to forward motion along current heading (yaw ~0.95 rad) referenced by fresh tracked floor point-021 at 1.10 m, bearing -0.03 rad (essentially straight ahead); endpoint when point-021 range closes to <=0.70 m, then observe the new view and scan for blue A / green B before any further leg

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; re-read get_geometry for point-021 and visual_candidates; if the reference is lost or geometry unknown, reselect another tracked point and change scan direction with a short turn; abort if no safe motion is supported

subgoals.description: Change search branch due to review: rotate in place ~0.6 rad left from heading yaw~0.95 to ~1.55 because the forward leg lost its tracked reference and produced no blue-A or green-B evidence; then take a fresh frame to look for targets

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop and observe a fresh frame; if still no target visible, track a fresh floor feature at mid-image and commit to a short forward translation (not another scan-only turn); abort only if geometry is unusable

subgoals.description: Commit forward along current heading toward the fresh tracked floor feature point-022 (bearing -0.10 rad, range 1.17 m); advance ~0.35 m and stop when its range drops to <=0.90 m so the new view can be searched for blue A / green B

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a clear floor feature before another short move; abort if geometry is unusable

subgoals.description: Commit to a sustained forward leg along current heading (yaw 1.50 rad) using fresh tracked floor feature point-023 (bearing 0.036 rad, range 1.11 m) as observed reference; advance ~0.4 m to reach a new viewpoint and search for blue A / green B, with local endpoint when point-023 range drops to 0.75 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, inspect geometry; if point-023 is lost or floor geometry is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature for another short move or abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Commit to a sustained forward leg along current heading (yaw 1.50 rad) using the fresh tracked floor feature point-024 (bearing -0.04 rad, range 1.11 m) as observed reference; advance ~0.35 m to a new viewpoint to search for blue A / green B behind obstacle blockages

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame and inspect geometry; if point-024 is lost or floor geometry is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature for another short leg or abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Strategy review (70 decisions, no A/B novelty, active leg endpoint point-024 went stale): abandon the previous forward leg along yaw~1.50 and rotate left 0.6 rad to face a new search sector; reference is current tracked floor feature point-025 (bearing -0.058 rad, range 1.08 m); local endpoint is that reference sweeping to bearing >= 0.45 rad, after which a new forward leg will be committed

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame and re-read point-025 geometry; if the point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor/edge feature in the new view, then choose another sector or abort with a reason instead of repeating scan-only turns

subgoals.description: Sustained translation branch: advance 0.35 m straight ahead (yaw ~2.08 body-frame forward) over the floor region evidenced by tracked point-026 at 1.22 m, bearing -0.18 rad, to leave the initial/sector-scan loop; endpoint is point-026 closing to <=0.90 m. Then stop and inspect the new view for A/B candidates.

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-read point-026 geometry and any new target_candidate; if the tracked point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor/edge feature before choosing another short translation, or abort with a reason instead of repeating scan-only turns

subgoals.description: Commit to a straight-ahead translation over the floor region evidenced by tracked floor feature point-027 at 1.19 m range, bearing -0.08 rad; advance 0.35 m toward it to exit the scan loop and open new viewpoints, endpoint is point-027 closing to <=0.90 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-read point-027 geometry and any new target_candidate; if the tracked point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature before choosing another short translation, or abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Continue committed straight-ahead exploration leg over floor evidenced by tracked floor feature point-027 (currently 1.07 m, bearing -0.03 rad, straight ahead); advance 0.35 m toward it to open new viewpoints for spotting blue A or green B, endpoint is point-027 closing to <=0.80 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-read point-027 geometry and any new target_candidate; if the point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature before choosing another short move, else abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Commit to a short straight-ahead leg over floor evidenced by tracked floor feature point-028 (range 1.40 m, bearing -0.10 rad, nearly straight ahead); advance 0.35 m to open a new viewpoint for spotting blue A or green B; endpoint is point-028 range <= 1.05 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-read point-028 geometry and any new target_candidate; if the point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature before choosing another short move, else abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Advance 0.4 m straight ahead over floor evidenced by tracked feature point-029 (range 1.296 m, bearing 0.079 rad, nearly centered); commit to this forward leg to open a new viewpoint for spotting blue A then green B; endpoint point-029 range <= 0.95 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-read point-029 geometry and any new target_candidate; if the point is lost or the view is unusable, re-track a clear floor feature before choosing another short move, else abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Advance 0.3 m straight ahead over floor evidenced by freshly tracked feature point-030 (range 1.335 m, bearing 0.378 rad left); sustained forward leg toward the open area to reveal blue A then green B; endpoint point-030 range <= 1.05 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a clear floor feature; if geometry unusable and no new candidate appears, switch search branch or abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Sustained forward leg along the open floor evidenced by freshly tracked floor feature point-031 (range 1.262 m, bearing 0.489 rad left); commit straight ahead 0.3 m to reveal blue A (then green B) beyond the cabinet-side area; endpoint point-031 range <= 1.05 m

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a clear floor feature or new color candidate; if geometry unusable and no candidate appears, change search branch direction or abort with a reason

subgoals.description: Rotate left 0.5 rad from current yaw 2.19 rad to sweep a new sector for blue A / green B; commit to this direction, endpoint pose.yaw_rad >= 2.60

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a visible floor feature or color candidate; if nothing appears, translate to a new viewpoint instead of scanning again

subgoals.description: Translate forward 0.25 m toward the tracked floor feature point-032 (range 1.15 m, bearing 0.15 rad ahead) to change viewpoint and reveal sectors hidden by cabinets; endpoint is point-032 range <= 0.95 m, well inside the observed free ray

plans_in_md.recovery: stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a visible floor feature; if still no target appears, choose a new sustained direction with fresh geometry or abort

subgoals.description: Commit forward 0.25 m along the visible floor ray to tracked point-033 (range 1.13 m, bearing 0.21 rad left), changing viewpoint to reveal cabinet-occluded sectors; endpoint is point-033 range at most 0.90 m.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a visible floor feature, and either continue with fresh geometry or choose a new safe direction; abort if motion remains unsupported.

subgoals.description: Commit forward 0.3 m along the visible floor ray toward tracked point-034 (range 1.27 m, bearing 0.28 rad left) to change viewpoint and reveal cabinet-occluded sectors; local endpoint point-034 range at most 0.98 m.

plans_in_md.recovery: Stop, observe a fresh frame, re-track a visible floor feature, then either continue with fresh geometry or pick a new safe direction; abort if motion remains unsupported.
